name: Expert_AML_CCI
summary: This EA uses the CML_CCI signal filter, which combines a Commodity Channel Index (CCI) with a Moving Average, to generate trade entries and exits within the MetaQuotes standard Expert Advisor framework. It operates on signal thresholds for opening and closing positions, uses fixed lot sizing, and has no trailing stop or take profit/stop loss levels configured by default. The EA delegates all trading logic to the CExpert standard library infrastructure.
summary_zh: 该EA使用CML_CCI信号过滤器，将商品通道指标(CCI)与移动平均线结合，在MetaQuotes标准EA框架内生成交易信号。它通过信号阈值控制开仓和平仓，使用固定手数，默认不设置止损止盈和追踪止损。所有交易逻辑委托给CExpert标准库基础设施处理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于CML_CCI信号过滤器，即商品通道指数(CCI)经过移动平均平滑处理后生成交易信号。入场条件为：当综合信号强度超过开仓阈值(Signal_ThresholdOpen=40)时开仓，信号强度低于平仓阈值(Signal_ThresholdClose=20)时平仓。CCI指标默认周期为18，MA平滑周期为3，权重为1.0，表明该过滤器是唯一的信号来源。仓位管理采用固定手数模式(MoneyFixedLot)，默认0.1手，不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理仅设置了10%的百分比参数和固定手数，缺乏动态风险控制机制。策略没有设置止损(Signal_StopLevel=0)和止盈(Signal_TakeLevel=0)，也没有追踪止损，完全依赖信号阈值来平仓，这在市场剧烈波动时可能造成较大亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the CML_CCI signal filter, which smooths the Commodity Channel Index (CCI) with a Moving Average to generate trading signals. Entry conditions: a trade is opened when the composite signal strength exceeds the opening threshold (Signal_ThresholdOpen=40), and closed when it falls below the closing threshold (Signal_ThresholdClose=20). The CCI period is set to 18 with a MA smoothing period of 3, and the weight is 1.0, indicating this is the sole signal source. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (CMoneyFixedLot) with a default of 0.1 lots, without dynamic adjustment based on account balance. Money management only sets a 10% percent parameter and fixed lots, lacking dynamic risk control mechanisms. The strategy has no stop loss (Signal_StopLevel=0) and no take profit (Signal_TakeLevel=0), and no trailing stop, relying entirely on signal thresholds for exits, which can lead to significant losses during volatile market conditions.
pros: 使用标准CExpert框架，代码结构清晰规范，易于维护和扩展
CCI经MA平滑处理可减少虚假信号，提高信号质量
采用信号阈值机制开平仓，比单纯交叉信号更具灵活性和过滤能力
固定手数模式简单直观，适合初学者理解和使用
pros_en: Uses the standard CExpert framework with clean, well-structured code that is easy to maintain and extend
CCI smoothed by MA reduces false signals and improves signal quality
Signal threshold mechanism for entries and exits provides more flexibility and filtering than simple crossover signals
Fixed lot model is straightforward and suitable for beginners to understand and use
cons: 未设置止损和止盈(Signal_StopLevel=0, Signal_TakeLevel=0)，完全依赖信号平仓，极端行情下风险极大
固定手数不做动态调整，无法根据市场波动或账户风险自适应仓位大小
缺少追踪止损机制，盈利头寸可能因回撤而大幅缩水甚至转为亏损
仅依赖单一CCI信号过滤器，缺乏多时间框架或多指标确认，容易产生错误信号
未进行新K线检查(EveryTick=false缓解但未完全解决)，可能存在信号重复计算问题
cons_en: No stop loss or take profit configured (Signal_StopLevel=0, Signal_TakeLevel=0), relying entirely on signal-based exits which poses extreme risk during volatile markets
Fixed lot sizing without dynamic adjustment cannot adapt position size to market volatility or account risk
No trailing stop mechanism means profitable positions may give back significant gains or even turn into losses
Relies on a single CCI signal filter without multi-timeframe or multi-indicator confirmation, prone to false signals
No new bar check (EveryTick=false mitigates but does not fully resolve), potential for repeated signal calculations
improvements: 添加止损和止盈参数，设置合理的默认值以保护资金安全
增加多指标或多时间框架过滤条件，减少虚假信号提高胜率
引入动态仓位管理(如基于ATR的风险仓位计算)，替代简单固定手数模式
添加追踪止损功能以锁定浮盈，防止盈利头寸大幅回撤
improvements_en: Add stop loss and take profit parameters with reasonable defaults to protect capital
Add multi-indicator or multi-timeframe filtering conditions to reduce false signals and improve win rate
Introduce dynamic position sizing (e.g., ATR-based risk calculation) to replace the simple fixed lot model
Add trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits and prevent significant drawdowns on winning positions

risk_points: 未设置止损止盈，市场剧烈波动时可能导致巨额亏损
仅依赖信号阈值平仓，若信号延迟或失效则持仓风险不可控
固定手数不考虑账户余额和波动率，在不利行情下缺乏风险自适应能力
risk_points_en: No stop loss or take profit configured, which can lead to catastrophic losses during extreme market moves
Relies solely on signal thresholds for exits; if signals are delayed or fail, position risk becomes uncontrollable
Fixed lot sizing does not account for account balance or volatility, lacking risk adaptability in adverse conditions

It operates on signal thresholds for opening and closing positions, uses fixed lot sizing, and has no trailing stop or take profit/stop loss levels configured by default. The EA delegates all trading logic to the CExpert standard library infrastructure.
